task_description: Fix the payment acknowledgment email in src/components/dashboard/new-booking-dialog.tsx (and the shared signature in src/lib/email-signature.ts) so leading emoji/icons render inline/centered with their text instead of detaching to the far-left edge, at desktop and narrow/mobile widths. Root cause: the @media (max-width:640px) rule turns align="center" table cells into display:block cells that lose centering, and several emoji-leading blocks lack an explicit text-align. Fix is email-safe (table-based, inline styles): add text-align:center to the stacked-cell media rule and to the flagged emoji-leading blocks. Do not touch booking logic, save flow, bulk/draft, or GST/profit calcs, nor the LOGO/social tags.

verification.summary: Sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: bun install fails (npm 403), so `bun run build` and `npx tsc --noEmit` could not run locally and the email could not be rendered. Verified by code inspection + git diff: only the two email-template files changed (+9/-9), all additive text-align:center style additions inside existing inline-style strings within template literals (no backticks/interpolation touched, negligible TS syntax risk). No booking logic, save flow, bulk/draft, or GST/profit-calc code changed; LOGO and social tags untouched. No unit tests exist for email HTML; this is a pure markup fix. Repo CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: tsc --noEmit + vite build) validates on PR; a human should eyeball the rendered email in Gmail/Outlook/mobile.
